## How this resume is built
The CV source is `cv/cv.Rmd`, written in R Markdown with the [`vitae`](https://pkg.mitchelloharawild.com/vitae/) package and the `awesomecv` template. Each section is a tibble rendered with `detailed_entries()` or `brief_entries()`, so updating the resume means editing a table and re-knitting the PDF.
:::
